questions_md:
# Speed, distance, time - Practice Test - Year 8

Attempt all questions and show your working. Suggested time: 30 to 35 minutes.

## Section A: Consolidating (Questions 1-4)

**Question 1**

A car travels $180 \text{ km}$ in $2$ hours. Find its average speed.

**Question 2**

A cyclist rides at a steady $24 \text{ km/h}$ for $3$ hours. How far does she ride?

**Question 3**

How long does it take to drive $150 \text{ km}$ at an average speed of $60 \text{ km/h}$? Give your answer in hours and minutes.

**Question 4**

Share \$60 between Ella and Noah in the ratio $2 : 3$.

## Section B: Standard (Questions 5-16)

**Question 5**

A train travels at an average speed of $120 \text{ km/h}$ for $45$ minutes. How far does it travel?

**Question 6**

Josh walks from home to the shops. The table shows his distance from home at different times.

| Time (minutes) | 0 | 10 | 20 | 30 | 40 | 50 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Distance from home (km) | 0 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 3.5 |

He moves at a steady speed between any two times where his distance changes.

(a) Between which times was Josh not moving?

(b) Find his speed, in km/h, during the first $20$ minutes.

(c) Find his speed, in km/h, during the last $10$ minutes.

**Question 7**

A family drives $120 \text{ km}$ in $1.5$ hours, stops for lunch, then drives another $80 \text{ km}$ in $1$ hour. Not counting the lunch stop, find their average speed for the whole drive.

**Question 8**

Kate is paid \$28.50 per hour for the first $38$ hours she works in a week. For every hour over $38$, she is paid time and a half (one and a half times her normal rate). How much is she paid for a week in which she works $42$ hours?

**Question 9**

A cordial drink is made by mixing cordial and water in the ratio $1 : 4$. How many millilitres of cordial are needed to make $2$ litres of drink?

**Question 10**

On a particular day, $1$ Australian dollar (AUD) buys $0.65$ US dollars (USD).

(a) Convert $400$ AUD to US dollars.

(b) Convert $520$ USD to Australian dollars.

**Question 11**

A bushwalking map has a scale of $1 : 50\,000$. Two campsites are $6 \text{ cm}$ apart on the map. What is the actual distance between them, in kilometres?

**Question 12**

A bus leaves the depot at 9:40 am and travels $75 \text{ km}$ at an average speed of $50 \text{ km/h}$ without stopping. At what time does it arrive?

**Question 13**

Two electricians charge as follows. Ace Electrical charges a \$80 call-out fee plus \$60 per hour. Bolt Electrical charges \$95 per hour with no call-out fee. Jobs are charged in whole hours.

(a) Find the cost of a $2$ hour job with each electrician.

(b) For what numbers of hours is Ace Electrical cheaper? Show how you know.

**Question 14**

A sprinter runs $100 \text{ m}$ in $12.5$ seconds.

(a) Find her average speed in metres per second.

(b) Convert this speed to kilometres per hour.

**Question 15**

On a distance-time graph, distance from home is on the vertical axis and time is on the horizontal axis.

(a) What does a horizontal (flat) section of the graph show?

(b) Two straight sections both slope upwards, but one is steeper. What does the steeper section show?

**Question 16**

A car uses $6.5 \text{ L}$ of petrol per $100 \text{ km}$. Petrol costs \$2.00 per litre. Find the cost of the petrol for a $340 \text{ km}$ trip.

## Section C: Advanced (Questions 17-20)

**Question 17**

Two towns, Ashby and Burton, are $300 \text{ km}$ apart along a straight railway line. At 9:00 am a train leaves Ashby towards Burton at $80 \text{ km/h}$. At the same time another train leaves Burton towards Ashby at $70 \text{ km/h}$. Both keep a constant speed.

(a) At what time do the trains pass each other?

(b) How far from Ashby are they when they pass?

**Question 18**

Three friends start a small business. Amir puts in \$2000, Bella puts in \$3000 and Chen puts in \$5000. At the end of the year they share a profit of \$4500 in the same ratio as the money they put in. How much profit does each person receive?

**Question 19**

Ruby drives $120 \text{ km}$ to the beach at an average speed of $60 \text{ km/h}$. She drives the same $120 \text{ km}$ home at an average speed of $40 \text{ km/h}$ because of heavy traffic.

(a) Find the total time for the round trip.

(b) Find her average speed for the whole round trip.

(c) Explain why the answer to (b) is not $50 \text{ km/h}$.

**Question 20**

Jess earns \$20 per hour and works $9$ hours each week. Each week she splits her pay between saving and spending in the ratio $1 : 2$. She already has \$120 saved, and wants to buy a bike that costs \$780.

(a) How much does she save each week?

(b) How many weeks will it take her to have enough money for the bike?
answers_md:
# Speed, distance, time - Answer Key

**Question 1**

Answer: $90 \text{ km/h}$

**Question 2**

Answer: $72 \text{ km}$

**Question 3**

Answer: $2$ hours $30$ minutes (also accept $2.5$ hours)

**Question 4**

Answer: Ella \$24, Noah \$36

**Question 5**

Answer: $90 \text{ km}$ ($120 \times \frac{3}{4}$)

**Question 6**

Answer: (a) from $20$ to $40$ minutes (b) $6 \text{ km/h}$ ($2 \text{ km}$ in $\frac{1}{3}$ h) (c) $9 \text{ km/h}$ ($1.5 \text{ km}$ in $\frac{1}{6}$ h)

**Question 7**

Answer: $80 \text{ km/h}$ ($200 \div 2.5$)

**Question 8**

Answer: \$1254 ($38 \times 28.50 = 1083$, plus $4 \times 42.75 = 171$)

**Question 9**

Answer: $400 \text{ mL}$ ($\frac{1}{5}$ of $2000 \text{ mL}$)

**Question 10**

Answer: (a) $260$ USD (b) $800$ AUD ($520 \div 0.65$)

**Question 11**

Answer: $3 \text{ km}$ ($6 \times 50\,000 = 300\,000 \text{ cm}$)

**Question 12**

Answer: 11:10 am (trip takes $1.5$ hours)

**Question 13**

Answer: (a) Ace \$200, Bolt \$190 (b) $3$ or more hours (Ace is cheaper when $80 + 60h < 95h$, so $h > 2\frac{2}{7}$; e.g. $3$ hours: Ace \$260, Bolt \$285)

**Question 14**

Answer: (a) $8 \text{ m/s}$ (b) $28.8 \text{ km/h}$ ($8 \times 3.6$)

**Question 15**

Answer: (a) the person or object is stopped (distance not changing) (b) a faster speed (more distance covered in the same time)

**Question 16**

Answer: \$44.20 ($6.5 \times 3.4 = 22.1 \text{ L}$, $22.1 \times 2$)

**Question 17**

Answer: (a) 11:00 am (closing speed $150 \text{ km/h}$, $300 \div 150 = 2$ h) (b) $160 \text{ km}$

**Question 18**

Answer: Amir \$900, Bella \$1350, Chen \$2250 (ratio $2 : 3 : 5$)

**Question 19**

Answer: (a) $5$ hours ($2 + 3$) (b) $48 \text{ km/h}$ ($240 \div 5$) (c) she spends more time driving at the slower speed, so the average is pulled below the halfway value of $50$

**Question 20**

Answer: (a) \$60 ($\frac{1}{3}$ of \$180) (b) $11$ weeks ($660 \div 60$)
check_notes: All speeds, times, ratio shares and money amounts recomputed in Python with exact Fraction arithmetic; electrician break-even checked by brute force.
